The Internship Recruiting Team is driven by the passion to recognize and develop emerging talent. Our year-round program places the best students in positions where they will grow technically, professionally, and personally through their experience working closely with their Manager, Mentor, and team. We are dedicated to providing an experience that allows the intern to experience life at Tesla by including them in projects that are critical to their team’s success.
About the Team
The Steering Software team is looking for a Validation Engineering intern to develop and execute test cases, bring-up and maintain Hardware in the Loop (HIL) testers and validate new steering features and functions. This role is crucial to releasing high-quality software to our existing customers and new product development. Creating, maintaining, and scaling highly efficient and effective validation systems gives us more confidence in our releases and changes.
The Steering Software team is responsible for steering controls, ranging from low-level embedded drivers to high-level application logic. Come join a team of deeply knowledgeable engineers that strive to build the most robust and reliable embedded systems using cutting-edge software development tools and practices. entries.title: Cloud Infrastructure Network Monitoring and Automation Software Engineer Intern - Dallas, TX - 2027
entries.description:
Introduction
At IBM, work is more than a job. It is a calling: To build. To design. To code. To consult. To think along with clients and sell. To make markets. To invent. To collaborate. Not just to do something better, but to attempt things you have never thought possible. Are you ready to lead in this new era of technology and solve some of the world's most challenging problems? If so, let's talk.
About Business Unit
IBM Cloud is the global public cloud platform from IBM, one of the most secure, scalable, and enterprise-ready cloud platforms in the world. IBM Cloud powers thousands of enterprises with Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS), Platform as a Service (PaaS), and Software as a Service (SaaS) offerings delivered across public, private, and hybrid cloud models.
Within IBM Cloud, the Network Underlay organization is responsible for designing, building, and operating the physical and software-defined network infrastructure that underpins IBM Cloud's global fleet of data centers. NetTools is the automation and tooling engineering team within Network Underlay. We build the software systems that allow network engineers to provision, configure, monitor, and manage network infrastructure at scale, across dozens of data centers globally.
The Network Automation mission within NetTools develops and operates three interconnected platforms: NCS/Axon (Network Configuration Service), the system that automates the full lifecycle of network switch configuration from initial rack bring-up to day-to-day operations; SSOT (Source of Truth) and Hivemind, the authoritative data stores for network configuration state in classic and next-generation data center environments respectively; and the associated monitoring, validation, and reporting pipelines that keep our network infrastructure compliant, observable, and reliable.
Your role and responsibilities
As a Back-End Software Engineering Intern on the NetTools Network Automation team, you will work alongside the engineers actively building and evolving the Axon/NCS platform and the SSOT/Hivemind systems. This is a hands-on engineering role: you will contribute directly to production-grade back-end services and automation pipelines that are critical to the daily operation of IBM Cloud's network infrastructure.
Your work will include:
Contribute to the Axon/NCS project: participate in the development of back-end Python microservices that implement Day-0 (initial network provisioning, Zero Touch Provisioning) and Day-2 (operational changes, firmware updates, configuration drift remediation) automation workflows. This includes working on REST API endpoints, YAML-driven input processing, and Jinja2-based configuration generation pipelines that produce switch conf+B30igurations deployed across IBM Cloud data centers.
Build and improve automated test coverage: help design and implement unit and integration tests for the Axon/NCS platform. One of the team's active priorities is establishing a regression test framework and test environment; the intern will make direct contributions to closing that gap, including authoring test cases, identifying edge conditions, and validating end-to-end workflow correctness.
Support SSOT and Hivemind integration work: assist in developing or improving the interfaces between NCS/Axon and the SSOT/Hivemind data platforms (backed by NetBox and CockroachDB), ensuring that network context data (rack topology, port mappings, cable connections, device inventory) is reliably consumed and validated by the automation workflows.
Reduce technical debt and improve documentation: contribute to the ongoing NCS Overhaul initiative by helping refactor tightly coupled components, improving Docker container configuration practices, and writing operational runbooks and onboarding documentation that are currently incomplete or missing.
Participate in agile delivery: work within the team's sprint-based development model: track work in Jira, attend standups and sprint ceremonies, contribute to code reviews, and share progress with cross-functional stakeholders across NetTools, Network Engineering, and Data Center Operations.
Required education
High School Diploma/GED
Preferred education
Bachelor's Degree
Required technical and professional expertise
Back-end development in Python: hands-on experience writing Python services or scripts, including working with data structures, JSON/YAML processing, and REST API design and consumption (e.g., Flask, FastAPI, or equivalent).
Version control with Git: ability to work collaboratively in a Git-based workflow, including branching, pull requests, and participation in code reviews.
Containerization fundamentals: familiarity with Docker, including building images, running containers, and understanding container-based service deployment. NCS runs as containerized workloads and container hygiene is an active operational concern on the team.
Understanding of REST APIs and HTTP: ability to design, implement, and consume RESTful APIs. The Axon architecture exposes Day-0 and Day-2 network build APIs consumed by multiple service teams across IBM Cloud.
Automated testing aptitude: experience writing unit or integration tests, or demonstrated understanding of why automated test coverage matters in production-critical infrastructure automation systems.
Preferred technical and professional experience
Working knowledge with one or more scripting or infrastructure tools: Bash, Ansible, Python automation scripts, or equivalent configuration management tooling.
Familiarity with template engines such as Jinja2, Helm, or similar. Configuration generation in NCS is built on Jinja2 templates rendered from YAML-based rack context inputs.
Exposure to container orchestration or cloud-native platforms: Kubernetes, OpenShift, or Docker Compose. NCS services run on IBM's Fabric Container Platform (FCP/OCP).
Basic understanding of networking concepts: IP addressing (IPv4/IPv6), VLANs, switching, routing fundamentals, or exposure to Zero Touch Provisioning (ZTP). Deep networking expertise is not required, but intellectual curiosity about network infrastructure is a strong plus.
Working knowledge with monitoring, observability, or ITSM tools: Grafana, Splunk, Zabbix, JIRA, ServiceNow, GitHub, or Confluence.

entries.description:
Position Overview
Be part of something groundbreaking. At AIG, we are making long-term investments in a brand-new, innovative Generative AI team, designed to explore new possibilities for how artificial intelligence can be applied in insurance and beyond, and we need your help.
With the support and investment needed to explore new frontiers in generative AI, you’ll be working alongside talented colleagues, innovating and leading projects that will transform how we manage risk and serve our customers.
This team is central to our vision of the future and the core of our business offering. We will incorporate best-in-class engineering and product management principles and your guidance and collaboration will be critical to its success. To rapidly advance and innovate, we need your skills and expertise to build and scale world-class products. If you’re excited by the opportunity to create meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you.
Who we are
AIG is a leading global insurance organization providing a wide range of property casualty insurance and other financial services. We provide world-class products and expertise to businesses and individuals in approximately 190 countries and jurisdictions.
At AIG, we’re reshaping how the world manages risk, and we’re inviting you to be a key part of that transformation. As a Senior Data Engineer for GenAII you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact, leveraging and further developing your skills to guide groundbreaking AI initiatives. If you’re looking for a place to grow your career and where your contributions will shape the future, AIG is where you belong.
How you will create impact:
As a
Full-Stack Software Engineer
for GenAI, you will be a part of the design, development, and operationalization of GenAI data pipelines that enable innovative AI models and analytics. You’ll collaborate across teams to deliver data solutions that drive business insights and value, all while ensuring scalability and sustainability. This is an exciting opportunity to shape the future of data engineering at AIG, guiding teams through complex data challenges and enabling AI-powered decision-making that will fuel business growth.
Your responsibilities include:
Collaborating with stakeholders to identify and deliver innovative data solutions that meet the evolving needs of the business.
Building and maintaining GenAI data pipelines across the business
Partnering with data architects and senior engineers to implement best practices, ensuring sustainable and scalable technical designs.
Working closely with analytics, application development, and data science teams to foster collaboration and drive innovation.
Delivering on-time, high-quality results on fast-paced schedules while maintaining rigorous standards for development and code management.

Be curious and motivated to learn new things
Design, develop and implement data processing pipelines in Palantir Foundry. Prior experience in Foundry is a big plus but not required.
Minimum of 3 years of professional software development experience.
Strong proficiency in at least one high-level programming language (Python, Typescript, Java, JavaScipt/React), a strong background in Typescript is a plus but not required.
Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code.
Experience with testing frameworks (pytest, unittest).
An understanding of containerization and compute optimization
Build and maintain scalable and reliable APIs to expose data and functionalities to other services and applications.
Identify and implement performance optimization for existing code and data processing workflows, including leveraging containerization technologies for parallel execution.
Contribute to the design and architecture of our data platform and applications.
Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality and adherence to best practices.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines
Experience setting up E2E Engineering pipeline, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
It would be nice if:
You are passionate about exploring innovative AI and Generative AI technologies, using them to drive impactful solutions within large-scale enterprise environments.
You would enjoy working within the financial services or insurance industry and understand the unique data challenges these sectors face.
Veterans are encouraged to apply.
At AIG, we value in-person collaboration as a vital part of our culture, which is why we ask our team members to be primarily in the office. This approach helps us work together effectively and create a supportive, connected environment for our team and clients alike.

entries.description:
What to Expect
This position is expected to begin January 2027 and continue through April 2027. Internships at Tesla are generally full-time, onsite roles that last a minimum of 12 weeks.
International Students: If your work authorization is via CPT, consult your school regarding your ability to work 40 hours per week before applying. You must be able to work 40 hours per week onsite. Many students will be limited to part-time during the academic year.
About the Team
As a Software Integration Engineer Intern, you will be responsible for ensuring firmware support for new battery management features and new hardware are designed, implemented, and tested to achieve Tesla's standards for safety and customer experience. Battery Management Systems are comprised of the controllers and firmware that monitor the battery, ensure it is delivering the most power and energy possible while maximizing capacity retention over life. BMS software integration engineers are responsible for the performance of algorithms that predict available power and energy, and functions that ensure optimal charging, effective thermal management and high voltage safety monitoring.
What You’ll Do
Work with the design and development engineers throughout the engineering organization to ensure the relevant subsystems are designed with appropriate
entries.requirements:
requirements, interfaces and interactions to achieve specific vehicle functions
Break down new, high-level feature requests into sub-system and component level requirements, and drive the implementation, testing and release of these features against Tesla’s firmware release schedule
Utilize critical analysis of potential failure modes and effects to influence these requirements
Develop overall validation strategy for these features and work with validation teams to ensure automated test coverage is implemented for future firmware releases
Work cross-functionally across mechanical, electrical, system architecture, firmware development and firmware validation teams to understand new component-level hardware changes which are being developed and how to support them in firmware – both in manufacturing and for customer use – so that they can be seamlessly introduced to our vehicle platforms
Develop and execute firmware integration test plans on new hardware components and firmware features to rapidly retire risk from new designs and provide feedback to the development teams to accelerate our aggressive development cycles
Dig into data and source code to identify and debug issues at the system level and propose robust solutions
Work with manufacturing and with service to ensure the function(s) are rolled out and functioning properly. This can include development of processes, diagnostic tools and methods, and root-cause diagnosis for product issues
Develop prototype test setups to integrate new subsystems with simulated and actual vehicle components
What You’ll Bring
Currently pursuing a degree in Mechatronics, Electrical, Computer Engineering, or a related field of study with a graduation date between May 2027 – May 2028
Hands-on technical experience debugging complex systems involving networked microprocessors and software-controlled electrical or electromechanical devices
Experience with C or C++ required, Python is a plus
Thorough understanding of mechanical fundamentals - and ability to apply them to automotive concepts
Ability to read and understand electrical schematics
Experience with CAN and Ethernet networking is a plus   Experience with Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) and Hazard Analysis and Risk Assessment (HARA) is a plus
Compensation and Benefits
Benefits
As a full-time Tesla Intern, you will be eligible for:
Medical plans > plan options with $0 payroll deduction
Family-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits
Dental (including orthodontic coverage) and vision plans. Both have an option with a $0 payroll contribution
Company Paid (Health Savings Account) HSA Contribution when enrolled in the High Deductible Medical Plan with HSA
Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
401(k), Employee Stock Purchase Plans, and other financial benefits
Company Paid Basic Life, AD&D, and short-term disability insurance (90 day waiting period)
Employee Assistance Program
Sick and Vacation time (Flex time for salary positions), and Paid Holidays
Back-up childcare and parenting support resources
Voluntary benefits to include: critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, theft & legal services, and pet insurance
Commuter benefits
Employee discounts and perks program
Expected Compensation
$42.07 - $58.89 + benefits
Pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

entries.requirements:
Minimum qualifications
Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
4 years of experience in communications, public relations, or public affairs.
Preferred qualifications
Experience working on large events and projects that require cross-functional collaboration.
Experience working in various areas of public policy and the energy industry or ability to quickly learn complicated and nuanced spaces.
Ability to develop and maintain media relationships across business and technology press.
Ability to use and adopt AI tools in the work.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to craft compelling narratives and build relationships with key stakeholders.
Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet tight deadlines.
About the job
As a member of the Google Cloud Communications team, you will collaborate with other cross-functional teams to communicate with journalists and thought leaders, develop specific communications materials and devise thought leadership campaigns. You'll understand the power of Google’s Cloud products and tell the story of how we help our customers innovate. You'll engage in face-to-face meetings with internal executives and external opinion formers, and develop print and web-based materials supporting these campaigns.
As a key member of the Google Cloud Communications team, you will work cross-functionally on the execution of key U.S.-focused PR campaign initiatives that support Google’s global infrastructure. Working closely with the U.S. energy campaign manager, you will help educate the market on the economic and societal benefits of the physical infrastructure that powers Google’s products and services around the world, driving stories in local, state, and national media. Additionally, you will maintain strong relationships with journalists and influencers; develop written materials and messaging; and help project-manage aspects of the campaign. A major part of the role is moving fast, while collaborating effectively with multiple teams across the organization.
We help inform and educate users, advertisers, partners, opinion leaders--and our own employees--about the benefits of Google's products, our distinctive company culture/values and our approach to the big public policy issues of the day. You are quick-witted, entrepreneurial and intellectually curious. To succeed in this role, you are willing to try new things and can manage numerous projects with tight deadlines. Things happen quickly at Google, and to do great work, you need to be an enthusiastic team player who can work cross-functionally with partners across PR, Communications, Marketing, Product, and beyond.

Help drive the external communications campaign in support of Google’s data centers and infrastructure across the United States.
Develop, write, and edit compelling communications materials, including announcements, key messaging, and more.
Be a trusted advisor and strategic thought partner to key business partners.
Cultivate local, state, and national media relationships to drive awareness about how Google works with communities to build data centers the right way.
Think creatively, take smart risks, and address tough issues.

From IT security and platform engineering to architecture, software development, and infrastructure, we offer career opportunities at every level – internships through technical leadership.
Join a company consistently ranked among Fortune’s “100 Best Companies to Work For” and help us build more than great subs – build the future of technology at Publix.
The Publix Technology Asset Protection & Vendor Portal team is responsible for developing, delivering, and maintaining robust, high-quality solutions to support the Vendor Portal and Asset Protection business areas. The team manages and enhances systems that impact both external partners and internal associates, ensuring smooth business processes and compliance with regulatory standards. As an Intermediate Software Engineer, you will be responsible for providing application development solving complex business challenges and comprehensive support for a wide range of systems under Vendor Portal and Asset Protection area.
Location: Hybrid (Lakeland, FL): To support our hybrid work model, candidates must reside, or be willing to relocate, within a commutable distance of Lakeland, FL.

Empowered Culture: We value autonomy, creativity, and continuous learning—your ideas shape the future of technology in our organization.

Provide KPIs, metrics, status, and reports to management and stakeholders.

Work with minimal supervision within a large fast-paced corporate environment.

entries.title: Data Engineer I (Databricks, AWS, Python)
entries.description: Who Are We? Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That’s the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it. Job Category Data Analytics, Data Science, Technology Compensation Overview The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards. Salary Range $109,300.00 - $180,200.00 Target Openings 1 What Is the Opportunity? Travelers Data Engineering team constructs pipelines that contextualize and provide easy access to data by the entire enterprise. As a Data Engineer, you will play a key role in growing and transforming our analytics landscape. In addition to your strong analytical mind, you will bring your inquisitive attitude and ability to translate the stories found in data. You will leverage your ability to design, build and deploy data solutions that capture, explore, transform, and utilize data to support Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning and business intelligence/insights. Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. The company does not sponsor/support H-1B petitions, TN, or Forms I-983/STEM OPT, for this role. What Will You Do? Build and operationalize complex data solutions, correct problems, apply transformations, and recommend data cleansing/quality solutions. Design data solutions. Analyze sources to determine value and recommend data to include in analytical processes. Incorporate core data management competencies including data governance, data security and data quality. Collaborate within and across teams to support delivery and educate end users on data products/analytic environment. Perform data and system analysis, assessment and resolution for defects and incidents of moderate complexity and correct as appropriate. Test data movement, transformation code, and data components. Perform other duties as assigned. What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have? Bachelor’s Degree in STEM related field or equivalent. Six years of related experience. Leverage AI Expertise : experience with OpenAI and AWS Bedrock to drive innovative projects. Technical Proficiency : skills in Python, SQL, AWS, Databricks, and more to develop robust AI applications. Terraform Experience : Terraform expertise to streamline infrastructure management and deployment. API Design Skills : designing and implementing APIs that power seamless integrations and functionalities Proficient use of tools, techniques, and manipulation including Cloud platforms, programming languages, and an understanding of software engineering practices. The ability to deliver work at a steady, predictable pace to achieve commitments, decompose work assignments into small batch releases, and contribute to tradeoff and negotiation discussions. Demonstrated track record of domain expertise including the ability to understand technical concepts and possess in-depth knowledge of immediate systems worked on. Proven problem solving skills including debugging skills, allowing you to determine source of issues in unfamiliar code or systems and the ability to recognize and solve repetitive problems. Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interact with team members and business partners. Leadership - Intermediate leadership skills with a proven track record of self-motivation in identifying personal growth opportunities. What is a Must Have? Bachelor’s degree in computer science, related STEM field, or its equivalent in education and/or work experience. 2 additional years of software/data engineering experience. What Is in It for You? Health Insurance : Employees and their eligible family members – including spouses, domestic partners, and children – are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment. Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers. Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays. Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs. Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice. Employment Practices Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions. If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you. Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting. To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/ .

entries.title: Software Engineer II, Android
entries.description:
The Team or Role
Recs Experience turns Tinder’s recommendation systems into flexible, reliable, and easy-to-use product capabilities that power better experiences across the app. We simplify the complexity of recommendations so teams can build with them confidently, while helping members find more relevant connections faster through clearer, more personalized, and more responsive experiences.
As a Software Engineer II on Android within Recs Experience, you’ll help build the experiences that shape who Tinder members see, how recommendations appear, and how profiles turn into matches and conversations. You’ll partner closely with backend engineers to deliver features end to end—connecting recommendation logic, APIs, and experiments to polished Android experiences, analytics, and quality validation. You’ll grow your Android and recommendations-domain expertise while helping a collaborative, full-stack team improve discovery for millions of members worldwide.
The team is engineering-led and works closely with Recs ML and Infrastructure, Product, Data Science and Analytics, Design, QA, and engineering partners across Tinder.
Where you’ll work
This is a hybrid role based in Palo Alto, California, and requires in-office collaboration three times per week.
In this role, you will
Contribute to the architecture, design, and implementation of consumer-facing recommendation features in the Tinder Android app.
Build polished, intuitive experiences that connect recommendation logic, APIs, experiments, analytics, and quality validation for millions of members worldwide.
Own well-scoped features and components from planning and implementation through testing, experiment launch, and validation, with increasing independence.
Collaborate closely with Android and backend engineers, Product, Design, Data Science and Analytics, QA, ML, Infrastructure, and partner teams across Tinder.
Write maintainable, well-tested Kotlin code and help protect app health, performance, reliability, and member experience.
Build modern Android interfaces with Jetpack Compose while working effectively with existing View-based or legacy code where needed.
Investigate bugs, ANRs, performance regressions, and other quality issues using a structured approach; identify root causes and add appropriate tests or monitoring.
Contribute to modular Android architecture, shared libraries, technical improvements, code reviews, and engineering practices that make the team more effective.
Communicate progress, risks, dependencies, and technical tradeoffs clearly and proactively.
Develop expertise in Tinder’s Android architecture, card-stack and recommendation systems, and progress toward broader end-to-end project ownership.
Use AI-assisted development tools effectively and responsibly to improve prototyping, implementation, testing, delivery speed, and quality.
You’ll need
Approximately 2+ years of professional experience building and shipping production, consumer-facing applications with native Android technologies.
Proficiency in Kotlin and modern Android development, including Kotlin Coroutines and Flow.
Experience building user-facing features with Jetpack Compose and familiarity with Android Views and interoperability.
Experience using Android Studio, Gradle, and the Android SDK throughout the application-development lifecycle.
Experience consuming REST APIs and integrating mobile features with backend services.
Familiarity with common Android architecture patterns such as MVVM and separation of UI, business logic, and data access.
Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows such as pull requests and code reviews.
Ability to write testable, maintainable code and create unit or UI tests using tools such as JUnit, Mockito, Espresso, or Compose UI testing.
Solid debugging and code-quality fundamentals, including the ability to give and receive actionable code-review feedback.
Clear, solution-oriented communication and a willingness to learn and collaborate in a cross-functional environment.
An ownership mindset with the ability to deliver well-scoped work, surface risks, and follow through from implementation to launch validation.
Nice to have
Experience working with Java or RxJava in an existing production Android codebase and modernizing code toward Kotlin and Coroutines.
Familiarity with modular Android architectures, dependency injection, repository patterns, and use-case layers.
Experience with Dagger or Hilt, Retrofit, OkHttp, Moshi, or related Android networking and dependency-management tools.
Experience with static analysis and quality tooling such as Detekt, ktlint, Android Lint, snapshot testing, or performance testing.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines, feature flags, experimentation platforms, product analytics, design systems, or mobile observability tools.
Experience building recommendation, discovery, personalization, social, messaging, marketplace, or other feature-rich consumer experiences at scale.
Familiarity with card-stack, gesture-heavy, animation-rich, or performance-sensitive mobile interfaces.
Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and responsible practices for validating generated or unfamiliar code and protecting sensitive information.
A BS or MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline is welcome but not required; demonstrated proficiency in modern Android technologies and principles matters most.

entries.title: Software Engineer, Operational Tools
entries.description:
Zoox is hiring software engineers to build the tools that power our autonomous ride-hailing service. The Operational Tools team plays a critical role in bringing Zoox’s vision of autonomous mobility to life.
We’re building a collaborative, high-performing team with diverse technical backgrounds and perspectives. If you’re excited about creating impactful software and tackling one of the most ambitious engineering challenges of our time, we’d love to hear from you.
Our Operational Tools enable the safe, reliable, and scalable operation of Zoox’s growing fleet of autonomous robotaxis. As a member of the team, you’ll work closely with product managers, designers, QA engineers, and remote operators to develop full-stack web applications that support fleet monitoring and operations at scale. You’ll also help build in-vehicle visualization systems and real-time rider support tools that directly shape the customer experience.
This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy solving complex, cross-functional problems, working across domains, and building innovative systems with visible, real-world impact.
In this role you will:
Design and implement highly scalable and reliable web applications to support Zoox's autonomous robotaxi service under the supervision of more senior engineers
Collaborate with software engineering teams, PMs, designers to build new features.
Collaborate with experienced engineers to enhance existing software systems by optimizing latency, CPU/memory usage, and database queries.
Have the chance to grow into a Senior Engineer with the support of your manager, mentor and team members.
